name: vinktar
description: Error tracking and product analytics for small teams. After adding it, open your project and ask Claude to set up Vinktar: it installs the SDK, checks the data arrives, and answers questions about your events and errors. Signing in is yours to do: Claude Code asks for it, and in Claude Desktop you connect Vinktar on this plugin's Connectors tab or at claude.ai/customize/connectors.
